svg.title: Bare metal — from a racked machine to a cluster node

color: rgb(51, 65, 85) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
A machine arrives
no OS · no agent · powered off

div.style: color: rgb(30, 41, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
1 · OUT-OF-BAND MANAGEMENT
BMC on its own network
IPMI (legacy) · Redfish (REST)
power · boot device · virtual media · sensors
the only way in before an OS exists

div.style: color: rgb(30, 58, 138) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
2 · NETWORK BOOT CHAIN
DHCP offers opt 66 (server) + 67 (bootfile)
TFTP loads a small NBP → iPXE chainloads
HTTP fetches the real kernel
UEFI HTTP Boot skips TFTP entirely

div.style: color: rgb(22, 78, 99) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center; width: 380px;

span.p:
3 · INSPECTION / DISCOVERY
boot a ramdisk, enumerate the truth
CPU · RAM · NICs + MACs · disks · GPUs · firmware
inventory is discovered, not typed into a spreadsheet

div.style: color: rgb(76, 29, 149) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
4 · IMAGE THE DISK
prebuilt image — fast, deterministic
or an installer — kickstart · preseed · autoinstall
image-based wins for fleets

div.style: color: rgb(19, 78, 74) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center; width: 380px;

span.p:
5 · CONFIGURE
cloud-init / Ignition for first boot, Ansible for the rest
BIOS + firmware settings are configuration — version them
GPU nodes: SR-IOV · above-4G decoding · IOMMU · power profile

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center;

span.p:
6 · JOIN THE CLUSTER
kubeadm · Cluster API + Metal³

div.style: color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center; width: 380px;

span.p:
THE TOOL LANDSCAPE
OpenStack Ironic — the mature engine
Canonical MAAS — full lifecycle + UI
Tinkerbell — CNCF, workflow-based
Metal³ — bridges Ironic to Cluster API, so bare metal becomes a Machine

div.style: color: rgb(127, 29, 29) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 380px; text-align: center; width: 380px;

span.p:
WHAT IS DIFFERENT FROM CLOUD
you cannot autoscale what is not racked
lead time is WEEKS, not seconds
failures are physical — a node that will not POST, a bad DIMM,
a NIC that renamed itself, thermal throttling
capacity planning becomes procurement
always-on cost, so utilisation is the metric that matters
